d:
Khabargaon is covering the Bihar Assembly Elections 2025. In this video, reporter Bhupinder Soni travels in the Patna Metro and talks to passengers about their experiences and opinions.
People share what they think about the Patna Metro project - whether it is fully completed, how it is changing daily life, and what it says about Bihar’s development.
Khabargaon is a modern-day digital platform that helps you travel through current affairs, explainers, ground reports, interviews and unique video shows. Stay tuned for more and more!
